identity.name: PINDER-S
identity.found_evidence: Public PINDER evaluation source, documented pinder_eval command, published test inputs and methods runner; no reproduction performed.

outcome_definition.scientific_question: Whether greater parallel search improves recovery of experimental protein-protein interfaces within fixed compute or time budgets.
outcome_definition.aggregation: Report top-ranked pose separately from best DockQ among a fixed number of generated candidates. Report per-case and aggregate acceptable-pose recovery.
outcome_definition.aggregate_acceptance_reason: No published required recovery fraction or reproduction tolerance established in inspected sources.

DockQ score legend and published references

source_licences_and_intended_use_permiss.intended_use: Scientific benchmarking and modification of docking search; separate AAV redocking challenge.

pinder_curated_data.reason: Repository licence verified; no explicit separate grant covering hosted curated dataset established in bounded source review. Underlying PDB coordinates are CC0.

frodock.reason: PINDER does not distribute docking software; its linked upstream download returned HTTP 404. No upstream terms verified.

stock_cuda_image.reason: Stock image identity and installed packages were not supplied. No install or workload run. Python >=3.10, fastpdb wheel requiring Linux glibc >=2.34 or Rust source build; FroDock Dockerfile requires Linux amd64, MPI, FFTW and compiler. CPU implementation could coexist with CUDA, but this is not verified.

observed_runner_risks.finding: predict uses pd.from_csv and expects preprocessed setup CSV; pandas dependency is unpinned. README CLI syntax differs from Fire implementation.
Wrapper changes into an empty temporary directory and refers to receptor/ligand basenames; executable paths concatenate directory and binary without explicit separator. Untested.

size.reason: No exact selected-input byte inventory or measured peak working set. Full-release and complete-test-set sizes are not selected 93-case working-set measurements.

repeatability_rules.case_selection: Fix all 93 paired-apo PINDER-S cases from release 2024-02 before performance runs; no scale search.
repeatability_rules.seed_reason: Brief requires independent seeds but supplies no seed values, repeat count or complete published stochastic configuration.
repeatability_rules.candidate_count_reason: Inspected FroDock runner requires n_solutions; no published experiment value found.
required_records: exact case IDs and input hashes
